# Transfer GmbH — Private Airport Transfers & Fernfahrten ab Trenčín

> Licensed private transfer service from Trenčín across Central Europe.
> Fixed prices per vehicle, professional drivers, available 24/7, multilingual (DE/SK/CS/EN).

## About
Transfer GmbH provides private door-to-door transfers from Trenčín to airports and
major cities in Slovakia, Austria, Czech Republic and Poland. Fixed prices (Festpreis),
no hidden fees, licensed and insured. All prices are per vehicle.

## Services
- Airport transfers: Bratislava (BTS), Vienna (VIE), Katowice (KTM), Prague (PRG)
- City transfers: Wien, Praha, Bratislava, Košice, Brno, Banská Bystrica and more
- Regional transfers: Oravský Podzámok, Podhájska, Nové Zámky
- Private individual and group transport (up to 8 passengers)

## Routes & Prices (Cenník platný od 15.7.2024)
All routes start from Trenčín. Price is Festpreis (fixed) per vehicle.

| Route | Price (EUR) |
|---|---|
| Trenčín → Bratislava Airport (BTS) / Letisko Bratislava | 90 € |
| Trenčín → Bratislava | 100 € |
| Trenčín → Brno | 100 € |
| Trenčín → Nové Zámky | 100 € |
| Trenčín → Banská Bystrica | 110 € |
| Trenčín → Oravský Podzámok | 120 € |
| Trenčín → Podhájska | 120 € |
| Trenčín → Vienna Airport (VIE) / Flughafen Wien / Letisko Viedeň | 145 € |
| Trenčín → Vienna / Wien / Viedeň / Vídeň | 155 € |
| Trenčín → Katowice Airport / Flughafen Katowice / Letisko Katowice | 185 € |
| Trenčín → Košice | 225 € |
| Trenčín → Prague / Prag / Praha | 235 € |
| Trenčín → Prague Airport (PRG) / Flughafen Prag / Letiště Praha | 245 € |

## Booking
- Send a request via the website form or WhatsApp.
- Price and pickup time are confirmed shortly after the request.
- Multilingual booking: German, Slovak, Czech, English.

## Payment
Cash and credit card. Currency: EUR. No hidden fees.

## Availability
24/7 — including early-morning flights and late-night arrivals.
Child seats available on request (free of charge).

## Languages
German (de), Slovak (sk), Czech (cs), English (en).

## Contact
- Website: https://transfer-gmbh-demo.vercel.app
- WhatsApp / phone and full contact details: see the website contact section.
